svg.title: FundBot. A facts only FAQ assistant for four Mirae Asset mutual fund schemes. Ask about expense ratios, exit loads, SIP and lump sum minimums, benchmarks, riskometer levels or ELSS lock in, and get a short answer with the official source linked. The model never supplies a fact: it only rewrites a passage retrieval already chose, and if it fails the passage is returned as is. Example: asked for the exit load of Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund, FundBot answers that it is 1% if units are redeemed within 365 days of allotment, and none after that, citing miraeassetmf.co.in as read in June 2025. Schemes covered: Large Cap Fund (NIFTY 100 TRI), Flexi Cap Fund (Nifty 500 TRI), ELSS Tax Saver Fund (NIFTY 500 TRI), Midcap Fund (NIFTY Midcap 150 TRI). Live at mf-faq-cbmark1.vercel.app.

div.div: Mirae Asset mutual fund FAQ assistant
div.p: Ask a factual question about a fund. Get a short answer with the official source linked, or an honest refusal.
The model never supplies a fact.It only rewrites a passage retrieval already chose. If it fails, the passage is returned as is.

div.div: What is the exit load of the large cap fund?

Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund charges an exit load of 1% if units are redeemed within 365 days from the date of allotment. No exit load applies after 365 days.
SOURCE miraeassetmf.co.in · June 2025
